answer: Five reviewers, drawn at random, judge each item; draw and verdicts are on the basalt board. Submitter locks 50 credits, pays 25. Each reviewer stakes 20 on pass/fail; majority split 25, dissenters lose 20. The majority verdict is a marble seal, open in a three-epoch glacier window: proven fraud burns the 50 bond and majority 20 stakes. One reviewer, one panel per epoch: the k-th fake needs fresh 50, 25, and three fresh 20 stakes. One thousand fakes risk 50,000 plus 25,000 fees; a rented-reviewer ring replaces 3,000 bought verdicts at 20, 60,000 more. Honest: one 25 fee, 50 returned on pass.
